description: rampart_20x_playground CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): the stack this plugin's own tests run in. The install set is this plugin alone, because it declares no dependencies: its two bundles (keystone, dimensions) write core entity types only. The consumer substitutes the checkout under test for the self entry, so the CHECKOUT runs. Population seeds this plugin's own GRIFT, which proves both bundles parse and import against a real grid. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets and any step that reaches the network, so a fork can run this lane and it cannot flake on a third party.
